IEOR · IIT Bombay

Academics

Undergraduate, master’s and doctoral pathways in industrial engineering and operations research.

Programs offered

From undergraduate study to independent research.

Bachelor of Technology

Industrial Engineering and Operations Research

An undergraduate path through engineering foundations, IEOR methods, laboratories, electives and project work.

Master of Technology

Industrial Engineering and Operations Research

Graduate study combining methods, applications, electives and a research thesis.

Master of Science

Operations Research

A four-semester path with foundational and advanced coursework and project work.

Master of Science–Doctor of Philosophy

Operations Research

An integrated route from postgraduate coursework toward doctoral research.

Doctor of Philosophy

Industrial Engineering and Operations Research

Original research with faculty guidance, culminating in a dissertation.
